actions.name: Exalted Orb
actions.description: Pinned RePoE client 4.5.5.2, base_items.json, Exalted Orb. Augments a [ItemRarity|Rare] item with a new random modifier Right click this item then left click a rare item to apply it. Rare items can have up to six random modifiers. Uniform removal/value rolls are a community model, not independently verified.

actions.name: Orb of Transmutation
actions.description: Pinned RePoE client 4.5.5.2, base_items.json, Orb of Transmutation. Upgrades a [ItemRarity|Normal] item to a [ItemRarity|Magic] item with 1 modifier Right click this item then left click a normal item to apply it. Uniform removal/value rolls are a community model, not independently verified.

actions.name: Orb of Augmentation
actions.description: Pinned RePoE client 4.5.5.2, base_items.json, Orb of Augmentation. Augments a [ItemRarity|Magic] item with a new random modifier Right click this item then left click a magic item to apply it. Magic items can have up to two random modifiers. Uniform removal/value rolls are a community model, not independently verified.

actions.name: Regal Orb
actions.description: Pinned RePoE client 4.5.5.2, base_items.json, Regal Orb. Upgrades a [ItemRarity|Magic] item to a [ItemRarity|Rare] item, adding 1 modifier Right click this item then left click a magic item to apply it. Current modifiers are retained and a new one is added. Uniform removal/value rolls are a community model, not independently verified.

actions.name: Orb of Alchemy
actions.description: Pinned RePoE client 4.5.5.2, base_items.json, Orb of Alchemy. Upgrades a [ItemRarity|Normal] or [ItemRarity|Magic] item to a [ItemRarity|Rare] item with 4 random modifiers Right click this item then left click a normal or magic item to apply it. Current modifiers are not retained. Uniform removal/value rolls are a community model, not independently verified.

actions.name: Chaos Orb
actions.description: Pinned RePoE client 4.5.5.2, base_items.json, Chaos Orb. Removes a random modifier and augments a [ItemRarity|Rare] item with a new random modifier Right click this item then left click a rare item to apply it. Uniform removal/value rolls are a community model, not independently verified.

actions.name: Orb of Annulment
actions.description: Pinned RePoE client 4.5.5.2, base_items.json, Orb of Annulment. Removes a random modifier from an item Right click this item then left click on a magic or rare item to apply it. Uniform removal/value rolls are a community model, not independently verified.

actions.name: Divine Orb
actions.description: Pinned RePoE client 4.5.5.2, base_items.json, Divine Orb. Randomises the numeric values of modifiers on an item Right click this item then left click an item to apply it. Uniform removal/value rolls are a community model, not independently verified.

actions.name: Fracturing Orb
actions.description: Pinned RePoE client 4.5.5.2, base_items.json, Fracturing Orb. [Fracture|Fracture] a random modifier on a rare item with at least 4 modifiers, locking it in place. Right click this item then left click a rare item to apply it. Cannot be used on Fractured items. Uniform removal/value rolls are a community model, not independently verified.
